retainedFailures.cause: Both positive responsive Create editing cases time out because the genuine right-arrow element intercepts the numeric text click; actual editing and native deletion remain unproved.

limitations: No whole-Hub loading improvement is inferred from fixture upload placement.
One public renderer.initTexture upload remains synchronous and may still stall.
GPU proof uses bundled Chromium153 and Firefox155; stock production Hub performance is measured separately.
No endurance test is required or scheduled.
